urban_adaptation_rate_90d.reason: No operational eligible-issue cohort or public-value outcome registry exists yet.
urban_adaptation_rate_90d.anti_gaming: fixed cohort; no denominator deletion; STOP reported separately

urban_adaptation_rate_365d.anti_gaming: registered horizon; cohort and unresolved cases remain visible

stop_compliance_rate.reason: Requires incident and stop-trigger logs from real experiments.
stop_compliance_rate.anti_gaming: verified triggers sampled independently; late or failed stops cannot be excluded

learning_closure_rate.reason: Requires an operational experiment and retirement archive.
learning_closure_rate.anti_gaming: all closeout states included, not only successful pilots

median_time_to_adaptation_days.reason: Requires timestamped issue and public-value decision records.
median_time_to_adaptation_days.anti_gaming: report by severity cohort; never reward delaying difficult issue intake

public_value_target_achievement_rate.reason: Requires registered pre-pilot targets and completed reviews.

equity_floor_pass_rate.reason: Requires valid subgroup or alternative equity review evidence.
equity_floor_pass_rate.anti_gaming: cannot infer sensitive attributes merely to populate the metric

human_override_effectiveness_rate.reason: Requires override event sampling and outcome review.
human_override_effectiveness_rate.anti_gaming: override availability alone does not count as effectiveness

choice_and_consent_coverage_rate.reason: Requires production exposure and consent/notice records; lawful-basis applicability is use-case specific.
choice_and_consent_coverage_rate.anti_gaming: denominator defined by governance applicability, not voluntary vendor reporting

complaint_resolution_within_sla_rate.reason: No operational complaint register or SLA exists yet.
complaint_resolution_within_sla_rate.anti_gaming: publish channel visibility and repeat complaints alongside rate

incident_detection_latency_days.reason: Requires timestamped incident records and an agreed start-time estimation method.
incident_detection_latency_days.anti_gaming: unknown incident start times remain unknown rather than forced to zero

rollback_readiness_rate.reason: Requires operational capability inventory and drill records.
rollback_readiness_rate.anti_gaming: paper rollback plans do not count as passed tests

capability_transfer_revalidation_rate.reason: Requires a future Capability Backbone transfer registry.
capability_transfer_revalidation_rate.anti_gaming: source-area success cannot waive target-area revalidation

data_minimization_compliance_index.formula: audited composite of necessity, field minimization, retention, access and deletion controls; component scores remain public
data_minimization_compliance_index.reason: Requires an adopted audit rubric and real data-processing inventories.
data_minimization_compliance_index.anti_gaming: never publish composite without components and exceptions

vendor_exit_readiness_index.formula: audited composite of exportability, substitution, continuity, contractual exit, decommission and knowledge portability
vendor_exit_readiness_index.reason: Requires procurement/vendor architecture not yet available.
vendor_exit_readiness_index.anti_gaming: documented exit plan alone is insufficient; evidence of tested portability is preferred

manual_intervention_disclosure_rate.reason: Requires operational intervention logs and independent sampling.
manual_intervention_disclosure_rate.anti_gaming: audit-derived denominator prevents invisible human labour from being omitted

manual_fallback_availability_rate.reason: Requires operational service inventory and fallback tests.
manual_fallback_availability_rate.anti_gaming: fallback must be usable under realistic outage conditions, not merely documented
